overall_note: The W and D structure, pivots, profiles and the daily layer all reproduce and match the chart. The M layer is misleading: a protected low from 2023 keeps M 'up' and 'premium', when the monthly has closed below its last HL and sits in the lower third of its active 1521-2417 range. And every HTF zone across 894-2270 is strong, several of them pivot+volume only.
